official_definition: DNA Digivolution (Your Turn) By returning two Condition family spirits you control to the hand, summon this card from your hand, without paying the cost.

ownership_rules.native_syntax: Ability block header contains [DNA Digivolution] or [DNA Digivolution: Param]
ownership_rules.prose_exclusion: Mentions inside body clauses ("with [DNA Digivolution]", "give [DNA Digivolution]") classified as REFERENCES or GRANTED, never NATIVE.

resolution.description: Mutates game state as specified by official effect text.
